sentences.text:
------------
 Advocate for : MR. S C BISWAS  Advocate for : PP  ASSAM appearing for THE STATE OF ASSAM AND ANR.
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MICHAEL ZOTHANKHUMA  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MALASRI NANDI

ORDER 18.10.2023 (M. Zothankhuma, J) Heard Ms. U. Nanda, learned counsel appearing on behalf of Mr.
S.C. Biswas, learned counsel for the appellant.

This is an appeal against the impugned Judgment & Order dated 25.08.2023 passed by the Special Judge, Chirang, Kajalgaon in Special POCSO Case No. 18/2019 convicting the appellant under Section 6 of the POCSO Act and under Section 376 (AB) IPC.
The appellant was thereafter sentenced under Section 376 (AB) IPC.
The appellant shall submit a scanned copy of the appeal to the Registry, who shall give the same to the learned Addl. PP, Ms. B. Bhuyan.
The learned Addl. PP shall thereafter transmit the same to the OC, Runikhata as the case pertains to Runikhata PS Case No. 29/2019.
The OC shall give a scanned or hard copy of the appeal to the respondent No. 2 and submit a report thereafter.
